Full-body wide stance keeps both boots grounded at the lower frame edge. The small head inclination and right-hand pluck repositioning are compatible with restrained rhythmic performance.
Four small body-control knobs are visible in this wider source and retain arrangement across the pair.
motion_conditions: Preserve four strings/posts/tuners, two pickups, controls, strap/body/neck geometry and connected hands through the take. No breathing instrument, phantom fret/fingers, string/tuner count changes or unsupported movement.
RIGHT fingers pluck/release plausibly near strings with thumb support, LEFT hand stays causally on neck; no sliding a frozen entire hand, melting fingers or gripping a second phantom neck.
Retain actor face/hair tie/goatee/cream shirt/embroidery/neutral chain and no new cross; low-amplitude cloth/hair/breath movement supports rather than substitutes for playing.
Keep feet planted and head movement slight; avoid repeated large synchronized bobbing or an unplanned step hidden by the lower crop.
